agent_messages:
I’ll read the drawing’s dimensions, build an editable PartDesign model with the AgentCAD tools, and check the shape in preview before saving the final file.
The main path resolves into tangent arcs: an R18 loop crown, R50 transitions into legs 5 mm apart, and an R174.5 tail followed by an R20 bend. The crimp sleeve is Ø14 × 20 mm. I’m checking the thin top view to resolve the wire section and R1 edge treatment.
I’ll use the sleeve’s bottom face as height zero. The checked callouts place the loop junctions at +39.79 and +62.88 mm, the short end at −10 mm, and the tail end at −105 mm with a 27.5 mm horizontal offset. The section appears to be 4 mm overall, with a 2 mm flat between R1 rounds.
The model builds as one valid solid in one PartDesign Body, with editable sketches, an additive sweep, and a sleeve pad. The previews match the drawing’s loop and tail layout. Measurements confirm the 20 mm sleeve, 10 mm short end, and 105 mm tail drop; the tangent junctions agree with the labeled dimensions within 0.01 mm.
Saved the final native model as `answer.FCStd`.

Verified one editable PartDesign Body, one valid solid, dimension checks, and rendered previews.

agent_messages:
I’ll read the drawing dimensions, build the module with native PartDesign features, then check its dimensions and rendered views before saving the final file.
The drawing shows an 80 × 36 mm board, four Ø3 mounting holes on 76 × 32 mm centers, a 71 mm display housing, and sixteen contacts at 2.54 mm pitch. I’m checking the side-view heights and the display opening before building the feature tree.
I’m using the board’s lower-left corner as the XY origin and its underside as Z=0. The side-view dimensions give a 2 mm board, housing top at Z=9, and pin tips at Z=−6, making the overall height 15 mm. I’ll use native sketches, pads, and pockets for the housing, recesses, mounting holes, side tab, and contacts.
The first model validates as one editable Body with one solid, measuring 80 × 36 × 15 mm. The rendered views match the drawing’s main layout. I’m checking the crowded lower-groove dimension, then I’ll verify the local heights and contact spacing before saving.
All 15 checks pass. The file contains one Body and one valid solid, with four Ø3 mounting holes and sixteen Ø1 pins at 2.54 mm pitch. I’ve inspected the final rendered views and am saving the final stage.
Saved the final native model to `answer.FCStd`.

Verified one editable PartDesign Body, one valid solid, 80 × 36 × 15 mm overall, four Ø3 mounting holes, and sixteen pins at 2.54 mm pitch. All 15 checks passed.
